<div class="card-body">
'''A Dark Time For The Rebellion''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊反乱軍の暗黒時代</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手が惑星位置を配備した直後に使用する。自分のリザーブ・デッキから同一の星系の星系カードを探してきて即座に配備する。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットしてもとの所に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-A-Dark-Time-For-The-Rebellion-PSA-154944002.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">皇帝は銀河を完全に掌握しており、帝国軍の支配は圧倒的で、反乱軍が足がかりを築くことさえままならない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Rebellion's dark age.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent deploys a planet site. Search your Reserve Deck for the system card of the same system and deploy it at once. Shuffle, cut and replace.

'''Lore:'''
The Emperor has a complete grip on the galaxy. Imperial rule is overwhelming, and the Rebellion can barely even gain a foothold.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
